title: PR-029: revision 3 not started 15 min after your change request

messages.text:
For you: you asked for a change on PR-029 ("End of the page: freeze the fading section's shimmer (rev 2: the flat cover is …") at 13:06Z, 15 min ago. Its author fix-end-morph has not said that revision 3 is under way. The lead has been told and will check; nothing for you to do.
Lead: ask fix-end-morph where it stands, then have it mark the work so the Proposals page shows it: node tools/console.mjs proposal revising PR-029 --by fix-end-morph --note "<the step it is on>" --eta +<N>m
One message per overdue period; this thread closes by itself when the revision is marked or posted, or the decision changes (tools/idle.mjs, I-177).
